title: Watson: attack on Bern butcher's freezer is first publicly known of its kind in Switzerland
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication on 27 November; the date of the butcher attack is not stated.
geo_basis: Switzerland; the article names canton Bern but no city or shop
summary: Watson reports that an attack over the internet on a butcher in canton Bern raised the freezer temperature to 50 to 70 degrees, and calls it the first publicly known cyberattack of this kind in Switzerland. The shop closed temporarily, checked all its systems and has reopened. Watson also reports attacks on three Volg branches and failed attempts at Coop.
plain: Watson reports a butcher in canton Bern was hit over the internet and its freezer heated to 50 to 70 degrees. The shop checked its systems and has reopened.
exec: Watson reports the first publicly known attack of this kind in Switzerland, hitting a food business's cooling system.

evidence.quote: stieg die Temperatur im Tiefkühler auf 50 bis 70 Grad

validation.note: Only Watson read; no statement from the butcher or Swiss authorities read.
